control_interpretation.complete_row_permutation: Moves slot content and its learned address together; near-invariance is expected up to numerical reduction order.
control_interpretation.exact_text: Charged exact-evidence reference, not parametric learning evidence.
control_interpretation.sealed_slot_shuffle: Reassigns slot content to original addresses; historical v12 gate interpretation is unchanged.
control_interpretation.semantic_wrong_source: Changes the answer-bearing source fact rather than only addresses.

decision.reason: Every pair retains nonzero slot and reader distinctions, while residual distinctions are smaller and eight final counterfactual pairs still have an incorrect side. Compression-loss is therefore not the decisive first hypothesis. Test whether fusion placement changes answer use before changing capacity.

limitations: Thirty-two exposed fitting rows only; development remains unopened.
Nonzero distances show retained distinctions, not sufficient information or calibrated confidence.
Reader/fusion causality requires the preregistered placement comparison.
Two fitting rule families and one seed do not establish broad generalization.
